question: Shambhu Maharaj was a renowned guru of which of the following Gharanas of Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is **Lucknow Gharana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shambhu Maharaj** was a legendary Kathak dancer and guru from the **Lucknow Gharana**.
 
• He was known for his mastery in **abhinaya** (expressive acting) and intricate **footwork**.
